Checked at start and each round: alive; no pain (an injury in the last round) or distress (satiety 0, body temperature below 7 or above 34); at least 0.5 energy. Another action, a refused round, too little energy, a limit, pain or distress pauses the bout without charge; voiced segments and their energy are never refunded. Death ends the bout and any study. improvise=true derives 4-6 notes from your id and the start round (FNV-1a and xorshift32; from 0, steps of -2..+2 within -3..+3, back to 0), never at random. No reward, mood change or practice milestone; listeners get only the heard entry, and no reaction is implied.
